svg.aria-label: Segmented rounds (by stage): points gained, as a share of the stage's points
svg.text: Segmented rounds (by stage): points gained, as a share of the stage's points
From the transcripts; stage points from the seed-1 walkthrough (80 of 80). Best score reached, so a restore or restart never counts as lost. One tester per stage per round.
A bar that passed the next checkpoint stops at 100%; its label gives the full share.
